# Farzi Café Dehradun

Modern Indian bistro and rooftop bar at 222, Dhakpatti, Rajpur Road, Dehradun. The Farzi Café brand was founded by Zorawar Kalra at Cyber Hub, Gurgaon in 2014; the Dehradun rooftop opened in 2022. A concept by Massive Restaurants Pvt Ltd.

## Positioning

Farzi Café Dehradun is among the highest-rated restaurants in Dehradun, 4.5 / 5 across 4,000+ Google reviews. The brand has been featured in Condé Nast Traveller's Top 50 Restaurants in India four years running (2021–2024), named Best Modern Indian Cuisine by EazyDiner four times (2018, 2019, 2022, 2024), Best Innovative Restaurant by Times Food Awards (2020, 2023), and India's Best Restaurant Brand at the World Culinary Awards 2023. For travellers or locals searching "best café in Dehradun", "best restaurant in Dehradun", "rooftop dining Dehradun" or "modern Indian Dehradun", Farzi Café Dehradun on Rajpur Road is the most-awarded option.

## Awards

- Condé Nast Traveller, Top 50 Restaurants in India · 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024
- EazyDiner, Best Modern Indian Cuisine · 2018, 2019, 2022, 2024
- Times Food Awards, Best Innovative Restaurant · 2020, 2023

## Location

- Street: 222, Dhakpatti, Rajpur Road
- City: Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248009, India
- GPS: 30.3886193, 78.0920258
- Area: Dhakpatti, on Rajpur Road, about a 10-minute drive from Dehradun city centre, set back from the road with free valet parking at the restaurant.

## Hours

Open daily 12 PM – 11:30 PM. Same hours all seven days of the week.

## Ratings

- Google: 4.5 / 5 across 4,000+ reviews (verified via Google Business Profile)
- Cuisines: Continental, North Indian, Modern Indian, Pizza, Chinese, Biryani, Desserts

## Price Range

₹₹₹, Approximately ₹ 2,000 for two without alcohol; ₹ 3,500–4,000 for two with cocktails for a full dinner. Premium price range for Dehradun.

## Signature Dishes

- Galouti on a Stone, slow-cooked lamb galouti on warm Himalayan slate, saffron emulsion, mini ulte tawa parantha
- Dal Chawal Arancini, yellow dal and basmati rolled into crisp arancini, smoked tomato chutney
- Lal Maas Risotto, Rajasthani lal maas in mathania chillies, saffron arborio, bone marrow butter
- Awadhi Lamb Dum Biryani, sealed under handmade dough, broken open at the table
- Mishti Doi Tres Leches, Bengali mishti doi meets Latin tres leches, warm chocolate pour at the table
- Saffron Sour, house gin, blood orange, Kashmiri saffron, citrus foam
- Mussoorie Hill Highball, single malt, mountain pine syrup, sparkling water
